input.content:
name: Artifact Pipeline

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build output
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          echo "build artifact contents" > dist/output.txt
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist/

  consume:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist
      - name: Use artifact
        run: cat dist/output.txt

part.text:
Created `.github/workflows/artifact-pipeline.yml`.

Key points:
- `build` job uploads `dist/` as artifact `build-output` via `actions/upload-artifact@v4`.
- `consume` job declares `needs: build`, so it only runs after the upload.
- `actions/download-artifact@v4` fetches it by the same `name`.

Note: artifacts are scoped to the run, so both jobs must be in the same workflow run. The `v4` actions require matching major versions on upload and download.
